setting: Weeks after their breakup, two former partners meet outside a cafe to return the last box of belongings.
lyrics:
I'm packing my bags 'cuz the journey is over
And we were never good enough for each other
You put me through hell every time that I tried
Tonight I'm gonna make you pay one last time

You ain't gotta be shy I want the neighbors to hear it
The way we used to do it in the beginning
So take your time
I'm waiting at the door
And imma do it do it do it do it do it 'til you want more

(Temperature's gettin' hot don't fight it)
I don't give a damn what you say you gotta do baby
(Kiss ya lips so soft then bite it)

When I'm through you gon' wish

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I nearly kept the mug you always used.
sentences.displayHtml: I nearly kept the mug you always used.

conversation.japanese: これで荷物は全部だよ。君がいつも使ってたマグカップ、危うく残しておくところだった。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I wanted to say something one last time, if that's okay.
sentences.displayHtml: I wanted to say something one last time, if that's okay.

conversation.japanese: 持ってきてくれてありがとう。よければ、最後に一つだけ伝えてもいい？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: If you're asking to try again, I can't do that.
sentences.displayHtml: If you're asking to try again, I can't do that.

conversation.japanese: やり直そうって話なら、それはできない。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I just know I took you for granted, and I'm sorry.
sentences.displayHtml: I just know I took you for granted, and I'm sorry.

conversation.japanese: そうじゃないよ。ただ、あなたがいてくれるのを当たり前に思ってたって、分かったの。ごめんね。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: We had some good times back in the day, didn't we?
sentences.displayHtml: We had some good times back in the day, didn't we?

conversation.japanese: そう言ってくれてありがとう。あの頃は楽しいこともあったよね。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I'm glad we can leave it there without another argument.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm glad we can leave it there without another argument.

conversation.japanese: うん、あった。また言い争いにならずに、これで終われてよかった。

lyricConnections.explanationJa: one last time は『最後にもう一度だけ』。ここでは関係を終える前に、伝え残したことを話す。
take someone for granted は『その人の存在や支えを当たり前だと思う』。話す相手に合わせて me を you に替えている。
back in the day は『昔は、あの頃は』。過去の思い出を振り返る口語表現。
